Class RenderTests

java.lang.Object
renderer.RenderTests
class RenderTests extends Object
End-to-end rendering tests.

These tests demonstrate the full rendering pipeline: scene construction → camera setup → ray tracing → image generation.

The first test produces a simple scene intended as a reference image for validating Camera and Renderer implementations.
